SUBSTITUTE TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
2821-23 S. Stewart Avenue

The Applicant seeks to rezone 2821-23 South Stewart Avenue from an M1-2 Limited
Manufacturing/ Business Park District to a RM-5 Residential Multi-Unit District to construct eight
(8) townhomes with attached single-car garages. The height of the building will be 30 feet, 9
inches. No commercial space will be provided. The surrounding area is improved with
residential uses and this application will bring the property into conformity with the surrounding
land uses.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks an administrative adjustment to reduce the
required separation between rows of townhomes from 26 feet to 24 feet (a 2-foot reduction) under
17-13-1003-U and to increase the number of off street parking spaces by 100% of the applicable
standard pursuant to 17-13-1003-EE. Pursuant to 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks a variation
to reduce the end wall setback from the street from 10 feet to 3 feet, 6 inches pursuant to
17-13-1107-B. The Applicant further seeks all relief available under the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance required for the plans subject to the zoning map amendment.
